purpose: Learn reusable single-glyph construction habits from component families without treating components as detachable font parts or using assembled-inscription adjacency as flow evidence.

study: relationship to host center of gravity
日.question: When 日 is an independent structural body versus a lower component, what remains stable and what compresses?

心.question: How can 心 support a dense upper structure without making the whole glyph bottom-heavy?

立.question: How narrow may 立 become while retaining its structural identity and stabilizing the right mass?

口.question: Which enclosure features survive running-script compression and which may open or merge?

study: transition from 矢-like upper/left mass toward 口
矢-知.question: What is the stable readable skeleton of 知 when compressed into the upper body of 智?

耑.question: Which features make the right side read as 耑 while allowing 端 to close firmly without becoming square and static?

dense-upper-plus-heart.question: How does a dense multi-layer upper body hand weight to 心 without creating a dark block?

antiLegoRule.statement: A component family is a behavioral memory, not a library of detachable shapes.
forbidden: copy 日 from one glyph and paste it unchanged into another
assemble a missing glyph by geometric component collage
average component outlines into a synthetic font radical
infer phrase flow from component evidence
required: re-solve proportion inside each host glyph
adapt compression and simplification to the whole character
record which evidence supports each reconstruction hypothesis

tc001Application.goal: Before any missing-glyph reconstruction, determine whether the project understands the teacher's component behavior well enough to predict constraints rather than paste shapes.

promotionGate.minimumEvidenceForStableRule: multiple verified Wang-form examples across at least two host glyphs or independent transmitted witnesses where possible
promotionGate.conflictingEvidence: retain variants and state-dependent rules; do not average them
promotionGate.transmissionNoise: stone/rubbing edge and thickness differences cannot become brush-pressure rules

nextGate.name: component-family-expansion-pass
nextGate.requirement: Expand 日、心、立、口、矢/知、耑 families from additional Wang-form characters, then mark stable invariants only where evidence crosses the promotion threshold.
